description: Main window: native file dialogs, OS opener, scoped asset reads for the covers cache (DR-44), and the five window commands the toolbar's own chrome needs (UI-07, D2): the three control buttons, the `start_dragging` call Tauri's drag-region script makes on the strip (DR-103), and `destroy`, which Tauri's own `onCloseRequested` plumbing calls to finish a close the app did not prevent (DR-105). No other capability is granted (RULES R1.5).
